questions.question_text:
A thermometer reads $11^{\circ}\text{C}$ below zero.
Which integer represents the temperature?

options.why: Used a positive sign even though the temperature is below the zero reference.
Used the reference temperature itself instead of moving eleven degrees below it.
Kept only one digit of the stated eleven-degree distance below zero.

questions.solution_text: Below zero is negative, so the temperature is $-11^{\circ}\text{C}$.

questions.question_text:
A tunnel chamber is $32$ m below the entrance.
Using the entrance as zero, which integer represents its position?

options.why: Used a positive sign for a position below the entrance.
Chose the entrance level instead of the chamber's position.
Reversed the digits of the stated distance $32$.

questions.solution_text: Below the entrance is negative, so the position is $-32$ m.

questions.question_text:
A player gains $14$ points.
Which integer represents this gain?

options.why: Represented a gain as a loss by using a negative sign.
Represented no change instead of the stated gain.
Dropped the tens digit from the stated gain of $14$ points.

questions.solution_text: A gain is positive, so the integer is $+14$.

questions.question_text:
A carpark is $8$ floors below ground.
Using ground floor as $0$, which integer represents its floor?

options.why: Used a positive sign for a floor below ground.
Chose ground floor instead of the carpark's floor.
Counted ground floor as one of the eight floors below ground.

questions.solution_text: Below ground is negative, so the floor is represented by $-8$.

questions.question_text:
The temperature is $23$ degrees below zero.
Which integer represents the temperature?

options.why: Used a positive sign for a temperature below zero.
Chose the zero reference instead of the stated temperature.
Reversed the digits of the stated distance $23$ below zero.

questions.solution_text: Below zero is negative, so the temperature is $-23^{\circ}\text{C}$.

questions.question_text:
A lookout is $175$ m above sea level.
Which integer represents its elevation?

options.why: Used a negative sign for an elevation above sea level.
Chose sea level instead of the lookout's elevation.
Dropped the hundreds digit from the stated elevation $175$.

questions.solution_text: Above sea level is positive, so the elevation is $+175$ m.

questions.question_text:
The share market dropped $2048$ points.
Which integer represents this drop?

options.why: Represented a drop as a gain by using a positive sign.
Represented no change instead of the stated drop.
Removed the zero digit from the stated drop of $2048$ points.

questions.solution_text: A drop is negative, so the integer is $-2048$.
